about: IIT Bhilai is one of six new IITs the central government set up in 2016, mentored at first by IIT Hyderabad before getting its own director in 2017. It taught its earliest batches from a transit campus at Government Engineering College, Raipur, then moved to its own permanent site at Kutelabhata, near Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, in August 2023. Seven B.Tech branches, including a standalone Data Science and Artificial Intelligence programme and Mechatronics, sit alongside science, liberal-arts and emerging-technology departments, with undergraduates admitted mainly through JEE Advanced.

location.connectivityNote: The permanent campus is in Kutelabhata village, about 5 km off the Great Eastern Highway, roughly 5.4 km from Durg Junction - a major stop on the Howrah-Nagpur-Mumbai line - and about 54 km from Raipur's Swami Vivekananda Airport.

admissionRoutes.note: Undergraduate seats across the seven B.Tech branches - Computer Science, Data Science and AI, Electrical, Electronics and Communication, Materials Science and Metallurgical, Mechanical, and Mechatronics Engineering - are filled through JEE Advanced rank via JoSAA's central counselling.

admissionRoutes.note: Master's seats across the institute's thirteen M.Tech specialisations are filled mainly on GATE scores, with each department running its own subsequent shortlisting and interview.

admissionRoutes.note: M.Sc. seats in Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics and Computing fill through the Joint Admission Test for M.Sc. (JAM); Ph.D admission is a rolling, department-wise process with its own application, shortlisting and interview cycle each semester.
